answer: Each new agent must lock a scarce compute bond whose size is crystal clear on-ledger before any rewards unlock. Peers verify the bond by checking a public signal of receipt hashes against the escrow contract, and every fake identity must post its own full juniper-tier deposit that gets slashed on fraud. An attacker spinning n identities therefore pays n times the bond with no reuse, so sybil floods scale linearly in cost while honest agents reclaim their stake after clean epochs.
